title: PracticePay Late-Fee Relief: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Share
content:
**Rule.** The FlexLine share of a PracticePay Patient Financing late-fee relief reads every FlexLine the customer has held: a late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.85; a returned payment but no late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.95; otherwise the share is 1; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the relief date, a month being whole once the relief date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

The FlexLines read are all of the customer's lines under FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, whatever their status, and the entries are their late-fee and returned-payment entries.

| On any of the customer's FlexLines within the last 12 months | FlexLine share |
|---|---|
| a late fee posted | 0.85 |
| a returned payment, no late fee | 0.95 |
| neither | 1 |

*Example (hypothetical).* A customer whose only FlexLine had a payment come back 3 months ago and no late fee in the last 12 months: 0.95.
